finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: Attacker-controlled data in the form of a very large integer could cause an overflow
finding.assumptions: The port number is typically a fixed value in real applications, but if it were dynamic and attacker-controlled, this could lead to an overflow.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the IP address were dynamically set from an untrusted source, this could potentially lead to command injection
finding.assumptions: The IP address is hardcoded, but if it were set from user input or a configuration file, this could be a risk.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.untrusted_source: None (fixed IP address and port number)
finding.trigger: If the IP address and port number were dynamically set from an untrusted source, this could potentially lead to command injection
finding.assumptions: The IP address and port number are hardcoded, but if they were set from user input or a configuration file, this could be a risk.
